description: This Java class defines the OrderFrequency entity in the OpenMRS project. It models the frequency at which an order is repeated, such as 'twice daily' or 'every 6 hours', and includes fields like orderFrequencyId, frequencyPerDay, uuid, and an associated Concept. It also includes getter and setter methods, and overrides for methods specifying metadata and identification.

classes.name: OrderFrequency
classes.description: An entity representing the frequency at which a medical order action should be repeated within the OpenMRS medical records system.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for the OrderFrequency instance.

methods.name: setOrderFrequencyId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the OrderFrequency instance.

methods.name: getFrequencyPerDay
methods.description: Returns the number of times the order should be repeated per day.

methods.name: setFrequencyPerDay
methods.description: Sets how many times per day the order should be repeated.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID associated with this OrderFrequency.

methods.name: setUuid
methods.description: Assigns a UUID to this OrderFrequency.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides method to return the identifier, delegated to getOrderFrequencyId().

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides method to set the identifier, delegated to setOrderFrequencyId().

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Concept object that describes this frequency.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the Concept object associated with this frequency.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the concept if available, used as the display name.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns description of the concept if available.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name for display purposes.
